configuration.initialization: Uniform behavioral strategy; CFR zero regrets, fictitious play one uniform prior observation, double oracle one uniform seed strategy per player.
configuration.comparison: Same game, payoff scale, iteration cap, full SPR target, diagnostic interval, repetitions, deterministic tie handling, and warm-up. Iterations have different work; compare time and work counts as well.
configuration.chance: Exact weighted enumeration; no sampling or training seed.

environment.timing: Warmed runs, constructor + solve including exact SPR checkpoints; excludes tree construction, post-run independent validation, policy export. History times include constructor. All repetitions rotate method order.
